summary: Iteration 2: verified Admin Inbox (JWT cookie auth), admin-only endpoints, brute-force lockout, and Photo Lightbox on tower-erection / quality-hse / home stills / foundation / narendra-pune-765 pages. 14/14 backend tests pass. All required frontend flows and data-testids work. Regression: home hero image /media/tower-erected-crew.jpg loads, WhatsApp button present, public enquiry POST 200.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: bcrypt.checkpw is CPU-bound; called inside async login handler without run_in_executor. Under load this can block the event loop. Consider `await asyncio.to_thread(bcrypt.checkpw, ...)`.
auth.py brute-force counter is per-email only, not per-IP. An attacker can enumerate emails to bypass. Consider adding an IP-based bucket in addition.
server.py: list_enquiries returns Enquiry with EmailStr; admin list endpoints don't paginate — 1000-doc cap fine for MVP but add limit/offset params soon.
admin login sets Secure cookie — only works on https. Confirmed OK on preview URL; document this for local dev.

CORS still uses `allow_origins=*` with `allow_credentials=True` (per env default). Browsers reject credentials on wildcard origin; only works because same-origin. Set explicit origins for future subdomain use.
